blockingIssues.description: Missing integration wiring. The router should dispatch tasks to channel session via A2A HTTP, but no router code was modified to use A2AClient.

appliedUpdates.description: Added note that supertest hangs on SSE endpoints and to use raw http module instead.
Added notes about Windows AggregateError for network failures and powershell requirement for PID resolution.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify if detached background process hooks (like auto-start/shutdown) are exempt from the 'All hooks must exit with valid JSON on stdout' rule. The existing reference pattern (`channel-auto-start.cjs`) exits silently, leading workers to copy the non-compliant pattern.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature build-a2a-autostart-hook correctly copied channel-auto-start.cjs behavior, resulting in process.exit(0) without JSON stdout.
